words.root_logic: sta（立）+ -ment（结果）→ 被立在那里、供人查看的一份东西 → 陈述、报表
words.origin: 拉丁语 stare（站立）经古法语 estat 进入英语
words.native_definition: something said or written clearly and officially, or a record of accounts
words.core_concept: something set down and left standing for others to check – 把话或账立在那里供人核对
words.core_image: 银行把一张对账单摊在柜台上，数字一行行立在纸面
examples: The minister issued a short statement.
Check your bank statement each month.
semantic_expansions: 陈述/声明：把话立在众人面前，立了就不能随口改
报表：把账目立成一份可核对的记录。中文分两个词，英文是同一个'立在那里供查'

words.root_logic: sta（立）+ -tion（名词）→ 固定站住的那个点 → 站、台、岗位
words.origin: 拉丁语 statio：stare（站立）的名词形式
words.native_definition: a fixed place where something stops or where someone is posted
words.core_concept: a fixed point where things come to a stop – 一个固定不动、供人物停靠的点
words.core_image: 月台立在原地，列车来了又走，它始终没动
examples: The train pulls into the station at noon.
He was posted to a remote station.
semantic_expansions: 车站：车流动而站不动，这是最直白的一层
电台/岗位：同样是固定不动的据点，只是停靠的是信号或人

words.root_logic: sta（立）+ -ic（形容词）→ 立着不动的 → 静止的
words.origin: 希腊语 statikos ← 与拉丁语 stare 同源的印欧词根
words.native_definition: not moving or changing; also unwanted noise in a signal
words.core_concept: staying in place without change – 停在原处不动、不变
words.core_image: 收音机指针一动不动，喇叭里只剩沙沙的杂音
examples: House prices remained static all year.
The radio gave off nothing but static.
semantic_expansions: 静止的：立着不动，最本义的一层
静电：电荷停在物体表面不流动
杂音：信号里不流动的那层底噪。三个中文词共享'不流动'这一个画面

words.root_logic: station（固定的点）+ -ary（属于…的）→ 属于那个固定点的 → 不动的
words.origin: 拉丁语 stationarius：statio（站立处）的形容词形式
words.core_concept: held at one point, not travelling – 停在一个点上不移动
words.core_image: 堵车时整排车停着不走，发动机还响着
examples: The traffic was stationary for an hour.
Keep the camera stationary while filming.
semantic_expansions: 不动的与静止的：中文两种译法，英文都是'钉在那个点上没走'

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ stit（sta 的变体，立）+ -ution → 在社会里立起来的东西 → 机构、制度
words.origin: 拉丁语 institutio：in-（进入）+ statuere（使立起，源自 stare）
words.native_definition: an established organization, or an established custom or law
words.core_concept: something set up and left standing in society – 在社会中立起来并延续下去的东西
words.core_image: 一栋石砌大楼立在城中，几代人换了它还在
examples: The bank is one of the country's oldest institutions.
Marriage is a social institution.
semantic_expansions: 机构：立在社会里的那个实体组织
制度/惯例：立起来并被延续的做法。同一个'立起来就留着'，一个是实体一个是规则

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ stit（立）+ -ution → 把各部分一起立成一个整体 → 构成、宪法、体质
words.origin: 拉丁语 constitutio：con-（一起）+ statuere（使立起）
words.native_definition: the way something is made up, or the fundamental law by which a state is governed
words.core_concept: how the parts are set up to stand together – 各部分被一起立成整体的方式
words.core_image: 一部法典摊在桌上，国家的骨架就照它立起来
examples: The constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
He has a strong constitution and rarely falls ill.
semantic_expansions: 宪法：国家骨架据以立起来的那份根本法
构成：各部分立成整体的方式
体质：人这副身体被立起来的底子。三个中文词都指'立成整体的构造'

words.root_logic: con-（一起、完全）+ clud（关闭）→ 把事情完全关上 → 结束、下结论
words.origin: 拉丁语 concludere：con-（一起）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to bring something to an end, or to decide after considering the facts
words.core_concept: shutting a matter for good – 把一件事关上，不再敞着
words.core_image: 法官合上卷宗，庭审到此为止
examples: The meeting concluded at five.
Police concluded that the fire was accidental.
The two sides concluded a trade deal.
semantic_expansions: 结束：把事情关上不再敞着
得出结论：把思考关上，落定一个说法
缔结（条约）：把谈判关上并定案。三层都是'合上、不再开着'

words.root_logic: ex-（在外）+ clud（关闭）→ 把某物关在门外 → 排除
words.origin: 拉丁语 excludere：ex-（外）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something out, or to leave it out of a group
words.core_concept: shutting something outside the boundary – 把某物关在界线之外
words.core_image: 门在来人面前合上，他被留在门外
examples: The price excludes delivery.
She felt excluded from the group.
semantic_expansions: 不包括（价格）：把这一项关在范围之外
排斥在外（人）：把人关在圈子之外。同一个'关在外面'，区别只在被关的是项目还是人

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ clud（关闭）→ 把某物关进范围之内 → 包含
words.origin: 拉丁语 includere：in-（内）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to have something as part of a whole
words.core_concept: shutting something inside the boundary – 把某物关进界线之内
words.core_image: 把一件东西放进箱子再合盖，它从此算箱内之物
examples: The price includes breakfast.
The team includes two new players.
semantic_expansions: 包括与包含：都是把某物关在范围之内，中文两种译法对应同一个动作

words.root_logic: exclude（关在外）+ -ive（倾向于…的）→ 惯于把别人关在外面的 → 独家的、排他的
words.origin: 拉丁语 exclusivus：ex-（外）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: limited to one person or group and shut off from others
words.core_concept: keeping others shut out – 把其他人一律关在门外
words.core_image: 会所门口只放持卡人进去，其余人一律拦在外面
examples: The magazine ran an exclusive interview.
It is an exclusive club with a long waiting list.
semantic_expansions: 独家的：其他媒体被关在外面，只有我有
高档的：普通人被关在外面，因而显得贵。同一个'把别人关在外面'落到不同场合

words.root_logic: se-（分开）+ clud（关闭）→ 单独关起来 → 隔离、隐居
words.origin: 拉丁语 secludere：se-（分开）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something away from other people
words.core_concept: shutting someone apart from others – 把人单独关开，断了往来
words.core_image: 山间独院，门一关就与外界断了往来
examples: She secluded herself in a mountain cabin to write.
The monastery secludes its novices for a year.
semantic_expansions: 隔离与隐居：都是单独关开、断绝往来，区别只在是否出于自愿

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ tain（握住）→ 把东西一起握在里面 → 容纳、控制住
words.origin: 拉丁语 continere：con-（一起）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to hold something inside, or to keep something under control
words.core_concept: holding contents together within bounds – 把内容一起握在界限之内
words.core_image: 双手捧住一堆沙，手一松就散
examples: This bottle contains two litres.
Firefighters contained the blaze by dawn.
semantic_expansions: 包含/容纳：把内容握在里面不让它散出去
控制（火势/疫情）：把它握在界限内不让扩散。同一个'握住不放它出去'

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向、对着）+ tain（握住）→ 伸手够到并握住 → 获得
words.origin: 拉丁语 obtinere：ob-（朝向）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to get something, especially by effort or by asking
words.core_concept: reaching out and getting hold of something – 伸手过去把东西握到手里
words.core_image: 隔着柜台把证件递过来，手一合就攥住了
examples: You must obtain written permission first.
The data was obtained from public records.
semantic_expansions: 获得与取得：都是伸手把东西握到手里，中文两种译法对应同一个动作

words.root_logic: re-（往回、持续）+ tain（握住）→ 一直握着不放 → 保留
words.origin: 拉丁语 retinere：re-（往回）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to keep something and not lose or give it up
words.core_concept: continuing to hold what one already has – 已经握着的继续不放
words.core_image: 水从指缝流走，手却仍攥着最后那一把
examples: The company retained all its staff through the downturn.
Sandy soil does not retain water.
She retains a clear memory of that night.
semantic_expansions: 保留/保持：握着的不松手
记住：把信息握在脑中不让它流走。同一个'不松手'，握的东西从实物变成记忆

words.root_logic: de-（离开原路）+ tain（握住）→ 把人从原本要去的路上握住 → 扣留、耽误
words.origin: 拉丁语 detinere：de-（离开）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to keep someone from leaving, officially or by delay
words.core_concept: holding someone back from going on – 把要走的人握住不让走
words.core_image: 机场安检把人拦下带进小房间，航班还在等
examples: Two suspects were detained for questioning.
Sorry to detain you — this will only take a minute.
semantic_expansions: 拘留（警方）：正式把人握住不放走
耽误（日常）：把人留住让他走不了。同一个'握住不让走'，区别只在有无强制力

words.root_logic: sus-（sub- 的变体，从下面）+ tain（握住）→ 从底下托住不让塌 → 维持
words.origin: 拉丁语 sustinere：sub-（从下）+ tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: to keep something going over time, or to bear the weight of it
words.core_concept: holding something up from below so it lasts – 从下面托住，使它持续不塌
words.core_image: 一只手在下面托住摇摇欲坠的书堆，手不撤书就不倒
examples: The economy cannot sustain this rate of growth.
The roof sustained heavy snow all winter.
semantic_expansions: 支撑/承受：从底下托住重量
维持（增长/生命）：从底下托住让它继续。同一个'托住不让塌'，一个是物理重量一个是过程

words.root_logic: pre-（在…之前）+ clud（关闭）→ 事情发生前先把门关上 → 预先排除
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecludere：prae-（在前）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: to make something impossible in advance
words.core_concept: shutting the door before something can happen – 在事情发生前先把路关掉
words.core_image: 闸门在洪水到来之前就已落下，水根本进不来
examples: His injury precludes any chance of competing.
The contract precludes further claims.
semantic_expansions: 排除与阻止：都是提前把门关上让事情无从发生，区别只在语气强弱

words.root_logic: include（关在内）+ -ive（倾向于…的）→ 惯于把人一起关在内的 → 包容的、含…在内的
words.origin: 拉丁语 inclusivus：in-（内）+ claudere（关闭）
words.native_definition: containing everything mentioned, or open to everyone
words.core_concept: keeping everyone and everything inside the boundary – 把所有人和项都关在范围之内
words.core_image: 圈子画得很大，所有人都被圈在里面，没人留在外头
examples: The price is inclusive of tax.
The school has an inclusive admissions policy.
semantic_expansions: 包含在内的（价格）：项目被关在范围之内
包容的（政策）：人被关在圈子之内。同一个'都圈在里面'，一个对物一个对人
